pages.title: Spell Machine
pages.text:
Can store one spell, uses mana bottles as mana source, can hold up to three mana bottles.

$(l)Usage:$()

$(l)Empty-handed right-click$(): Without mana bottle, opens spell editing interface.
$(l)Right-click with mana bottle$(): Places mana bottle into the machine.
$(l)Shift+right-click empty-handed$(): Takes out mana bottle from machine.
$(l)Right-click empty-handed with mana bottle$(): Executes stored spell.
